name: Book Covers
original_description:
Give the title, the author, the genre and an image idea, and get a book cover with the text in the design, in the tall format books use.

ChatGPT tells you what the run needs and creates the cover in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The cover opens in the chat and stays in your library.

For self-published authors, newsletters and book clubs.

Limitations: front covers as image files; it does not lay out the spine and back cover or publish the book. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
